cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Mum found the surprise-party invitations. Right on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me hide them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. She had to feel she'd uncovered it herself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's her part of the plan: taking control. We surprise her with how completely we obey.

mechanism: A supervises the surprise-party helper by correcting each failure into a planned stage of Mum regaining control.
confusable: Calling a setback an improvement differs from saying it was always intended; keep that retrospective design claim explicit.
comparison: A family helper wants to rescue catering rather than dispute a game score.
seedUse: Use invitations found and caterer cancellation; let B propose stopping the cancellation so A can correct an actual next action.
